name: close_window
description: Safely and cleanly closes a window matching target title using targeted Win32 messages (WM_CLOSE / SC_CLOSE). Does NOT affect other windows or the active foreground window.

force.description: If true, forcefully terminates the target process if graceful close does not respond.

target.description: Window title substring of the window to close (e.g. 'File Explorer', 'Notepad').
